newsitem.title: USA: HarCor Energy redeems senior notes.
newsitem.headline: HarCor Energy redeems senior notes.

text.p: HarCor Energy Inc said it has redeemed $3,290,000 of its 14-7/8 percent Senior Secured Notes at a price of 110 percent of par.
The company said it will incur a charge of about $2 million in the third quarter resulting from the early retirement of the notes.
The company added that on September 20, it served Notice of Redemption to the holders of the notes for the redemption of an additional $7,984,000 on October 21 at a price of 110 percent of par value.
Effective with the second portion of the redemption, HarCor said, it will have redeemed $11,274,000 of the notes and will have a remaining $53,726,000 (face value) outstanding.
The notes are being redeemed with proceeds from the company's recently completed stock offering, it said.
The company also said the holder of the 9 percent Series E Junior Convertible Preferred Stock has elected to convert all of 30,000 shares into 857,143 common shares.
HarCor said it will realize annual savings of $1,947,000 in interest expense and dividends resulting from the note redemptions and preferred stock conversion.
